citizenId.text: Type the player's fixed citizen ID, like 12. For the current session number put # in front, like #5. Old IDs like OMG95204 still work.

common.serverId: The session number changes every time the player joins, so we rely on the citizen ID. If you need it, put # in front, like #5.
common.copy: Copies the value so you can paste it somewhere else, like a message or a command. Changes nothing.
common.confirm: Carries out the action written in this window now. Read it before you press; some actions cannot be undone.
common.cancel: Closes the window without doing anything.
common.close: Closes this panel. Nothing you did or saved is cancelled.

typeToConfirm.text: Protection against a slip: type the requested text exactly, then the confirm button unlocks.

save.text: Saves your changes and applies them to every player at once, without a restart.
save.undo: Yes, by setting the value back or with Restore

common.discard: Throws away the changes you have not saved and puts the values back. Nothing changes on the server.

resetDefault.text: Puts this setting back to the value the script came with.
resetDefault.undo: Yes, type your value again and save

common.search: Filters the list by what you type: a name, a number or a word from the text.
common.density: Essential shows only the important columns; Detailed adds more, like money and health. It changes your view only.
common.level: Levels from lowest to highest: mod, then admin, then god. Each level can do everything below it.
common.locked: This is locked because your level is lower than required. Ask the owner to raise your level if you need it.
common.refresh: Fetches the latest data from the server now instead of waiting for the automatic update.

coords.text: A spot on the map as three numbers X, Y and Z. You can paste text like vector3(1.0, 2.0, 3.0) and it splits by itself.

common.duration: How long the penalty lasts. After that things return automatically; Permanent lasts until you lift it yourself.
common.reason: The reason is shown to the player and kept in the log. Write something clear, or pick a ready reason.
common.dismiss: Hides this notice. Nothing changes on the server.
common.unsaved: How many values you changed and have not saved. Players only get them after Save and apply.
common.status: The player's state now: Well, Low needs when hunger or thirst is under 20, Dead, or Frozen when staff are holding them in place.
common.retry: Tries to fetch the data from the server again.
common.refresh: Fetches the latest copy of this list from the server now. Changes nothing for players.
